Get date range string for dataset

Source: R/file_name_process.R
get_date_range_helper.Rd

Computes the overall date range from the date column of the input data frame, returning it as a single string. If all dates are identical, returns that single date.

Usage

get_date_range_helper(df)

Arguments

df

A data frame with a date column, it can be of different data types like string or Date, but must be in consistent format (e.g., "yymmdd", ""yyyy-mm-dd").

Value

A single character string:

"YYYY-MM-DD"

when all dates in df$date are the same

"YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD"

otherwise, concatenation of start and end dates

Returns NA_character_ (with a warning) if df has zero rows.

Details

  • Throws an error if df is not a data frame or lacks a date column.
